project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA with Vite build, full EdTech LMS for Zawia University (Arabic RTL)
build_system: Vite 5.4 + TypeScript 5.7. Build command: tsc -b && vite build. No Docker.
test_framework: No test framework configured in package.json. Verification via TypeScript type-checking.
build_command: Cannot run - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network prevents npm install. Use AST/syntax validation instead.
verification_instructions: 1. Validate CSS brace balance across all CSS files. 2. Verify TSX syntax is valid. 3. Check no duplicate custom property definitions. 4. Confirm RTL logical properties used (no directional left/right). 5. Verify prefers-reduced-motion queries on animations.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install npm packages, cannot download Google Fonts from CDN, cannot run build/test. Font loading via Google Fonts CDN in index.html already exists (IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Lexend, Outfit, Space Mono) - will work only in production. Use system font fallbacks.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing functionality. Full RTL support. WCAG 2.1 AA contrast. Responsive breakpoints: mobile <640px, tablet 640-1024px, desktop >1024px. No new external libraries.
key_patterns: CSS custom properties in tokens.css (dark/light themes via [data-theme]). Theme state in Zustand store (theme.store.ts). CSS layers: @layer tokens, base, components, pages, overrides. Multiple CSS files loaded in main.tsx in specific order. React components use className-based styling (no CSS modules). lucide-react for icons. IntersectionObserver-based Reveal component for scroll animations. CountUp component for animated numbers.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - all CSS files (tokens, base, components, landing, responsive, etc). frontend/src/pages/ - page components including LandingPage.tsx. frontend/src/components/ - reusable components (Icon, BrandMark, CountUp, layout/). frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores (auth, theme). frontend/src/hooks/ - custom hooks (useReveal).
